INSERT INTO rb_message
            (content, content_type, sender, sender_type,
            cost_id, cost_amount, unlock_at, unlock_after_seconds, unlocked, ticket_id)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
            CASE WHEN $7 > 0 THEN NOW() + ($7::BIGINT * INTERVAL '1 second') ELSE NULL END,
            $7, $8, $9)
        RETURNING id;
